22: **What lives in gen_ui_core (never re-implement in Dart/TS):**
23: - Tokio runtime (one per process, N-1 worker threads + 8 blocking threads)
24: - Anthropic API client (reqwest HTTP/2 + rustls, SSE streaming, prompt caching)
25: - A2UI protocol adapter (StreamEvent → A2uiEvent, 27 variants)
26: - AG-UI protocol adapter (A2uiEvent → AguiEvent, bidirectional)
27: - Local inference engines behind the `InferenceProvider` trait, chosen per **device**, not per "mobile/desktop": llama-cpp-2 desktop · LiteRT-LM Android · MLX-Swift iOS · MLX-C macOS · WebLLM web; mistral.rs optional (versions.toml [inference], `references/rust/inference-lanes.md`)
28: - SurrealDB embedded (RocksDB, MemoryStore + ToolCache + EntityGraph)
29: - UAR runtime facade (embedded, service, and deterministic test adapters)
30: - Governed tool execution inside UAR; raw MCP transports are not
31:   application-facing APIs
32: 
33: ## UAR integration modes
34: 
35: **Embedded (default for standalone and offline mobile apps):**
36: The pinned UAR runtime, governed tool boundary, and protocol pipeline run
37: in-process behind `UarRuntimeFacade`. Applications do not generate or own a
38: second agent loop.
39: 
40: **Service (desktop, web, and hosted execution):**
41: The application calls UAR through a typed BFF or service adapter. Appropriate
42: when UAR is shared infrastructure.
43:

59: Every A2UI event maps to exactly one ContentBlock variant:
60: 
61: | Block | A2UI Source | Platform widget/component |
62: |---|---|---|
63: | TextBlock | TextDelta | StreamingTextWidget / StreamText (assistant-ui) |
64: | ThinkingBlock | ThinkingDelta | ThinkingBlockWidget / ThinkingPart |
65: | CodeBlock | CodeBlock | CodeBlockWidget / CodeMirror 6 |
66: | CitationBlock | CitationBlock | CitationBlockWidget / CitationComponent |
67: | MemoryBlock | MemoryWrite/Read | MemoryBlockWidget / MemoryComponent |
68: | ToolUseBlock | ToolCallStarted/Complete | ToolUseBlockWidget / ToolCallComponent |
69: | ToolResultBlock | ToolResultReceived | ToolResultBlockWidget / ToolResultComponent |
70: | SkillBlock | SkillActivated/Complete | SkillBlockWidget / SkillComponent |
71: | ArtifactBlock | ArtifactBlock | ArtifactBlockWidget / Sandpack (Tauri) |
72: | ImageBlock | inline image | _ImageBlock / ImageComponent |
73: | DividerBlock | separator | Divider / hr |

75: ## Decision matrix summary
95: tooling — for a single product. Before committing a second product to this
96: architecture, name the owner (person, fraction of a person, or an agent-run
97: process with a human accountable) for:
98: 
99: - the frb + Tauri-plugin bridge surfaces (codegen, type sync, streaming seams)
100: - the embedded-engine lifecycle contracts (see `docs/pglite-oxide-tauri-hybrid.md`)
101: - `versions.toml` currency and the `audit.mjs doc-consistency` gate
